title: OpenEPCIS Assessment and Test Vocabulary
description:
How a Digital Product Passport states what was measured, tested or assessed about a
product: the assessment that was carried out, the method and the standard that define it, the
conditions and protocol settings it ran under, the results it produced, the criteria and
thresholds a result is judged against, and the indicators (scores, classes, expected lifetimes)
derived from those results.

The model follows the assessment pattern of the CIRPASS-2 EU DPP ontologies (textile-assessment,
textile-indicator): an assessment execution produces results; a result carries a measured value
with its unit and names the performance parameter it observes; an indicator is derived from
results and is never the result itself. Values with a unit are gs1:QuantitativeValue
(UN/CEFACT Rec 20 unitCode), so they read the same way as every other quantity in a passport.

The module sits below the DPP core: it imports only the GS1 Web Vocabulary, schema.org and
CCCEV, and oec: (dpp-core) imports it. Sector modules add their own performance parameters,
indicator kinds, test methods, standards and criteria as individuals of the classes here
(eutex:AbrasionResistance a oea:PerformanceParameter, eutex:MartindaleAbrasionTest a
oea:TestMethod), not new classes.

EPCIS binding: an assessment carried out on an item is an ObjectEvent with action OBSERVE and
bizStep inspecting. The event is the execution: eventTime, readPoint, bizLocation and the
source party say when, where and by whom; the oea:Assessment object hangs at event level under
oea:hasAssessment and carries method, conditions, settings and results. An equivalent compact
form uses the EPCIS sensorElementList: sensorMetadata.dataProcessingMethod names the method,
sensorMetadata.bizRules the standard, and each sensorReport carries one result with type set to
the oea:PerformanceParameter IRI, value and uom. See docs/EPCIS_BINDING.md.

EPCIS 2.0 Extension:
This vocabulary is a first-class EPCIS 2.0 extension per Section 12.3. Declare it using:
  GS1-Extensions: oea=https://ref.openepcis.org/extensions/common/assessment/

References:
- Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 (ESPR), Article 7 and Annex I (performance and information requirements)
- ISO/IEC 17025:2017, General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories
- CIRPASS-2 EU DPP ontologies, textile-assessment and textile-indicator modules
- SEMICeu Core Criterion and Core Evidence Vocabulary (CCCEV) 2.1

classes.label: Assessment
classes.comment: One concrete assessment of a product: a method applied to a specified product under stated conditions and protocol settings, producing results. An assessment made of several tests (a composite durability or recyclability scheme) lists them under oea:hasSubAssessment. When the assessment is reported in an EPCIS event, the event is the execution and supplies time, place and party.

classes.label: Assessment Condition
classes.comment: A condition under which an assessment was performed or a result obtained: a specimen type, a pre-treatment, an environment, a use scenario. Stated as a condition type plus a coded value, a quantity, or a description.

classes.label: Assessment Method
classes.comment: A documented procedure for assessing, testing, measuring or scoring a product. Methods are published once as individuals (eutex:MartindaleAbrasionTest, a JRC scoring method) and referenced by every assessment that applies them.

classes.label: Assessment Result
classes.comment: An output of an assessment: a measured value, a rating, an outcome against a criterion, or a textual finding, for one performance parameter.

classes.label: Assessment Standard
classes.comment: A normative or reference document that defines or constrains assessment methods, conditions or result interpretation: an ISO, EN, IEC or OECD standard, a harmonised standard, or a regulatory methodology such as a JRC preparatory study.

classes.label: Condition Type
classes.comment: The kind of an assessment condition: specimen type, pre-treatment, use scenario. Sector modules add their own.

classes.label: Assessment Criterion
classes.comment: A criterion a result or an assessment is judged against: a design rule, a requirement of a scoring method, a pass condition. Published once as an individual and referenced by every result that evaluates it.

classes.label: Criterion Result
classes.comment: An assessment result that records whether one criterion is met (oea:hasOutcome), the points a scoring method awards for it (oea:awardedScore), or both, without a measured value of its own.

classes.label: Indicator
classes.comment: A value derived from assessment results to interpret, aggregate or communicate them: a score, a class, an expected lifetime, a number of use cycles. An indicator names its kind, carries a quantity or a coded value, and points at the results and the method it was derived with. It is not a measured value.

classes.label: Measurement Result
classes.comment: An assessment result that records a quantitative value with its unit, or a grade on the scale the method defines (a 1-5 grey-scale rating has unitCode C62).

classes.label: Parameter Setting
classes.comment: The value a protocol parameter was set to in an assessment: 5 cleaning cycles, 40 °C, 12 kPa. A protocol parameter configures the test; it is not the product property the test observes.

classes.label: Test Execution
classes.comment: An assessment that performs a test method under controlled test conditions, typically in a laboratory per ISO/IEC 17025.

classes.label: Test Method
classes.comment: An assessment method that applies a controlled experimental or inspection procedure, usually defined by a test standard.

classes.label: Threshold
classes.comment: A criterion stated as a limit value: a performance parameter, a comparison operator and a quantity (elastane content at most 15 %, biodegradation at least 60 % in 28 days).

properties.label: Assessment Date
properties.comment: Date the assessment was performed. Only for assessments stated in master data; in an EPCIS event the eventTime says when.
properties.accessLevelRationale: When a public result was obtained.

properties.label: Awarded Score
properties.comment: Points a scoring method awards to this result or sub-assessment (spirality 0-3 points of a robustness score, 1 point per sorting factor met).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Component points of a public composite score.

properties.label: Calculation Description
properties.comment: How the indicator was calculated and on which assumptions, when no published method covers it.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Assumptions of a public indicator.

properties.label: Condition Description
properties.comment: Free-text description of the condition, when it is neither coded nor a quantity.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Description of a public test condition.

properties.label: Criterion Description
properties.comment: What the criterion requires, in words.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Text of a published criterion.

properties.label: Assessed Parameter
properties.comment: A performance parameter the assessment targets. Optional: each result names the parameter it observes.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Scope of a public assessment.

properties.label: Assessment
properties.comment: An assessment of the product, from the product master data or from an EPCIS OBSERVE event at event level.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The assessments behind a performance claim are part of the consumer-facing passport content under ESPR Article 7.

properties.label: Assessment Body
properties.comment: The laboratory, conformity assessment body or organisation that performed the assessment. In an EPCIS event the source party can say the same.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Who performed the assessment is part of its credibility, as notified bodies are named on declarations of conformity.

properties.label: Categorical Value
properties.comment: The indicator as a coded value from a module's list: a durability class, a shedding risk level, a recyclability grade.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Coded value of a public indicator.

properties.label: Comparison Operator
properties.comment: How the value is compared with the limit.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Operator of a published threshold.

properties.label: Condition
properties.comment: A condition the assessment was performed under.
properties.accessLevelRationale: A result is only comparable with the conditions it was obtained under.

properties.label: Condition Value
properties.comment: The coded value of the condition, an individual of the sector module's own list (eutex:WovenNonDenim for a specimen-type condition).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Coded value of a public test condition.

properties.label: Condition Type
properties.comment: What kind of condition this is.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Kind of a public test condition.

properties.label: Condition Quantity
properties.comment: The quantity of the condition, when it is a quantity.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Quantity of a public test condition.

properties.label: Criterion
properties.comment: The criterion this criterion result reports on.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Criterion of a public criterion result.

properties.label: Derivation Method
properties.comment: The method the indicator was calculated with (a scoring method, a lifetime estimation method).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Method of a public indicator.

properties.label: Evidence
properties.comment: A document substantiating the assessment: a test report, a certificate, a calculation sheet.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Test reports and certificates name laboratories, specimens and commercial detail; they substantiate the public claim for authorities and are not themselves public information.

properties.label: Indicator
properties.comment: An indicator stated for the product or derived by an assessment.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Scores, classes and expected lifetimes are the consumer-facing headline of the passport's performance information.

properties.label: Indicator Kind
properties.comment: What the indicator expresses.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Kind of a public indicator.

properties.label: Indicator Value
properties.comment: The indicator as a quantity: a score (unitCode C62), a lifetime (ANN), a number of cycles (C62).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Value of a public indicator.

properties.label: Measured Value
properties.comment: The value obtained, with its UN/CEFACT unit. A grade on the scale the method defines takes unitCode C62.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The measured value behind a public performance claim.

properties.label: Method
properties.comment: The method the assessment applied.
properties.accessLevelRationale: A result is only interpretable with the method that produced it.

properties.label: Observed Parameter
properties.comment: The performance parameter this result observes.
properties.accessLevelRationale: What a public result is about.

properties.label: Outcome
properties.comment: Whether the result, criterion result or whole assessment meets its criterion. On an assessment it states the overall verdict of the method (recyclable, passes ultimate biodegradability).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Pass/fail verdict of a public assessment.

properties.label: Parameter
properties.comment: The protocol parameter this setting assigns.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Parameter of a public protocol setting.

properties.label: Parameter Setting
properties.comment: A protocol parameter value the assessment was configured with.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Protocol settings (cycles, temperature) qualify a public result.

properties.label: Parameter Value
properties.comment: The value the protocol parameter was set to.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Value of a public protocol setting.

properties.label: Result
properties.comment: A result the assessment produced.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Assessment results are the substance of the public performance claim.

properties.label: Sub-Assessment
properties.comment: An assessment that is part of this one: the spirality, dimensional change and visual inspection tests of a composite robustness assessment.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Part of a public composite assessment.

properties.label: Threshold Parameter
properties.comment: The performance parameter the threshold limits.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Parameter of a published threshold.

properties.label: Threshold Value
properties.comment: The limit quantity.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Limit of a published threshold.

properties.label: Indicator Text
properties.comment: The indicator as text, for a class band that has no published code list (a repairability class 'B').
properties.accessLevelRationale: Textual value of a public indicator.

properties.label: Defined By Standard
properties.comment: A standard that defines or constrains the method.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Standard behind a public method.

properties.label: Derived From
properties.comment: A result, assessment or indicator this indicator was calculated from.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Provenance of a public indicator.

properties.label: Evaluated Against
properties.comment: A criterion or threshold the result, indicator or assessment was judged against; oea:hasOutcome says whether it was met.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Criterion of a public result.

properties.label: Maximum Score
properties.comment: The most points a scoring method can award for this criterion.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Weight of a published criterion.

properties.label: Method Name
properties.comment: Name and version of the method, for a method stated inline rather than as a named individual ("RecyClass v2.6").
properties.accessLevelRationale: Name of a public method.

properties.label: Method URL
properties.comment: Where the method is published, for a method stated inline rather than as a named individual.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Reference to a public method.

properties.label: Result Text
properties.comment: A finding stated as text, when the result is neither a quantity nor a coded outcome.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Textual finding of a public assessment.

properties.label: Standard Code
properties.comment: Designation of the standard, e.g. ISO 12947-2:2016.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Designation of a public standard.

properties.label: Standard URL
properties.comment: Catalogue page of the standard (iso.org, cen.eu, an ELI for a regulation).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Catalogue reference of a public standard.

enumerations.label: Comparison Operator
enumerations.comment: How a threshold compares a value with its limit.

values.label: Equal
values.comment: The value must equal the limit.

values.label: Greater Than
values.comment: The value must be above the limit.

values.label: Greater Than or Equal
values.comment: The value must reach at least the limit.

values.label: Less Than
values.comment: The value must be below the limit.

values.label: Less Than or Equal
values.comment: The value must not exceed the limit.

enumerations.label: Indicator Kind
enumerations.comment: What an indicator expresses: a recyclability score, a repairability score, an expected lifetime, a durability class. Sector modules add their own.

values.label: Expected Lifetime
values.comment: Lifetime the product is expected to reach under normal use (unitCode ANN). An estimate, not a measured property: it names its method and assumptions. Replaces oec:hasExpectedLifespan.

values.label: Number of Use Cycles
values.comment: Number of use, wash or charge cycles the product is expected to withstand (unitCode C62). A use indicator, not the protocol parameter oea:NumberOfCycles. Replaces oec:usageCycles.

values.label: Performance Class
values.comment: Performance or efficiency class band (A to G energy-label style). Replaces oec:performanceClass.

values.label: Recyclability Score
values.comment: Method-specific recyclability score (a JRC textile 0-10 score, a PPWR percentage). A score does not by itself prove that the product will be collected or recycled. Replaces oec:recyclabilityScore.

values.label: Repairability Class
values.comment: Repairability class band (A to E, A most repairable). Replaces oec:repairabilityClass.

values.label: Repairability Score
values.comment: Method-specific repairability score (French Indice de Réparabilité, EU repairability index; typically 0-10). Replaces oec:repairabilityScore.

values.label: Technical Lifetime
values.comment: Lifetime under the conditions stated in the indicator's assessment (unitCode ANN). Replaces oec:hasTechnicalLifetime.

enumerations.label: Measurement Parameter
enumerations.comment: A protocol parameter a test is configured with: number of cycles, temperature, duration, load, relative humidity. Distinct from the performance parameter the test observes.

values.label: Duration
values.comment: Test duration (unitCode DAY, HUR or MIN).

values.label: Load
values.comment: Mechanical load or pressure applied by the test (unitCode NEW or KPA).

values.label: Number of Cycles
values.comment: Number of repeated test, cleaning, abrasion or simulated-use cycles applied before or during a test (unitCode C62).

values.label: Relative Humidity
values.comment: Relative humidity of the test atmosphere (unitCode P1).

values.label: Temperature
values.comment: Test temperature (unitCode CEL).

enumerations.label: Outcome
enumerations.comment: Whether a result or an assessment meets the criterion it is judged against.

values.label: Not Applicable
values.comment: The criterion does not apply to the product.

values.label: Not Assessed
values.comment: The criterion was not evaluated.

values.label: Not Satisfied
values.comment: The result or assessment does not meet the criterion.

values.label: Partly Satisfied
values.comment: The result or assessment meets the criterion only in part.

values.label: Satisfied
values.comment: The result or assessment meets the criterion.

values.label: Uncertain
values.comment: The evidence does not allow a verdict on the criterion.

enumerations.label: Performance Parameter
enumerations.comment: A product characteristic an assessment observes: abrasion resistance, dimensional stability, biodegradation, recyclability rate. Individuals, not classes; sector modules add their own.

values.label: Biodegradation
values.comment: Share of a substance or material biodegraded under the test method's conditions (ultimate aerobic biodegradation, unitCode P1). Replaces oec:biodegradationPercentage.

values.label: Recoverable Rate
values.comment: Mass fraction of the product recoverable at end of life through any recovery operation: material recycling, energy recovery, backfilling (Waste Framework Directive Art. 3(15)). Replaces oec:recoverableRate.

values.label: Recyclability Rate
values.comment: Mass fraction of the product that can be recycled (unitCode P1, or C62 for a 0-1 fraction). Replaces oec:recyclabilityRate.

values.label: Recycling Collection Rate
values.comment: Fraction of products of this type actually collected for recycling under the applicable collection scheme. Replaces oec:recyclingCollectionRate.
